## November 22 Pennsylvania saved-estimate navigation

`a79ff3d0` uses the same original-receipt match for Continue and Preview
in the implemented 2025 single-filer Pennsylvania resident, part-year
and nonresident methods. A saved estimate must match a distinct actual
estimated-payment receipt by date and Decimal amount or be explicitly
removed. Navigation retains the original claim for review until the
taxpayer resolves it. A matched receipt counts once. The engine keeps
its own final admission check and its other reconciliation rules.

All three methods reproduced the early navigation on the original
browser revision. All three passed on the exact seven-file candidate.
Each case reopened the saved return, held Continue for $100.01 without
a matching original, then removed the claim and advanced with actual
records. Matching and removal controls passed all 46 focused
tests and 13 independent tests. The five specification references,
coverage inventory, browser audit, 60 related operations tests, web
typecheck and web build passed. The tracked candidate manifest SHA-256
is `9d19cc7c38ee8f9c3b1e54458c1a5ce9836ba925a903fe6a15f90dada4970fd9`.
[2025 PA-40 instructions, estimated payments and credits](https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/revenue/documents/formsandpublications/formsforindividuals/pit/documents/2025/2025_pa-40in.pdf).

closed in the app.

## November 22 Form 2106 native name rendering

The final 2026 Form 2106 asks for the taxpayer's name in the native
header. A qualifying $80 reservist lodging review failed at field
measurement for the synthetic name Jane Nguyễn. The same facts with an
ASCII name succeeded. [Final Form 2106](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f2106.pdf#page=1).

`11efa4a1` pins the upstream fontkit dependency, its type definitions,
and the static Noto Sans font. The font assets carry their upstream license
notices and travel with the existing blank template assets. `d078258a`
uses the original PDF font when it covers the full name and embeds Noto
Sans when needed. The candidate holds unsupported glyphs and over-width
names at the existing 9-point size. The saved native value retains the
original spelling. The scope remains the disabled 2026 review candidate.
[Font provenance](../forms/blank/_fonts/README.md).

The regression reproduced the WinAnsi failure before implementation.
All 85 scoped tests, six spec references, inventory validation and root
type checking passed. Scoped lint reported one existing warning and zero
errors. Strict pypdf reopening confirmed the original native value and
nonempty widget appearance, the $80 deduction and blank SSN fields.
The rendered header visibly showed the original spelling, and both pages
retained the review notice. Evidence is under
`.local/upgrade-evidence/nov22-form2106-unicode/`.

An isolated archive rerun stalled in the PDF-reader child. The test now
opens a private temporary file and removes it after the reader exits.
The identical strict field and appearance assertions passed in the
archive on all 85 selected tests.

## November 22 Form 2441 return-year confirmation

A saved 2026 care worksheet retained a $200 credit after changing to
2025, reopening the return and supplying matching-year personal and
interest facts. The 2025 calculation used that amount. The IRS Worksheet A
for 2025 applies to qualified 2024 expenses paid in 2025. `7968206c`
clears the Part II confirmation when a previously selected year changes
or is cleared. It preserves the entered records, including the Worksheet A
amount, and requires confirmation for the selected year. The same-year
and first-year assignment paths retain the existing confirmation behavior.
[Form 2441 instructions, line 9b and Worksheet A](https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i2441).

The regression first reproduced the carryover. After the change, the
return could calculate only after fresh confirmation. With all other
2025 facts identical, a verified $0 amount gave $2,875 total tax and a
verified $200 amount gave $2,675. All 496 scoped tests, 54 spec references,
root and web type checks, and the exact candidate inventory passed.
Scoped lint reported zero errors and 23 existing warnings. The audited
local browser run passed the federal and both Pennsylvania desktop/mobile
care scenarios at the existing 30-second deadline and shut down its
server. Only the text for the existing confirmation action changed in the
browser fixtures. Receipts are under
`.local/upgrade-evidence/nov22-form2441-current-year/`.

Vercel recorded the production-labeled builds for the reviewed main
commits through `7968206c` as canceled. The separate local full unit and
coverage attempts on `891f921b` reported 26 and 29 failures, respectively.
Both owned PostgreSQL instances stopped. The two remote full core runs
documented below passed.

The public Google recheck confirmed standard Gemini 3.8 Flash prices at
$0.75 for input and $3.75 for output per million tokens through December 31.
The rates rise to $1.50 and $7.50 respectively starting January 1, 2027.
This public catalog check made zero provider generation requests.
[Gemini standard pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing#gemini-3.8-flash).

## November 22 retained direct federal amounts

The year selector previously let certain scalar facts flow into the next
return after save and reopen. A controlled 2026-to-2025 replay with fresh
2025 personal and wage facts changed the calculated 2025 tax from $5,075
to $6,855 with $10,000.25 of retained manual gambling winnings, and from
$8,120 to $4,505 with $25,000 of retained medical expenses when itemizing.
It also reproduced unsupported changes from retained alimony and household
payroll. In the other direction, a $5,000.75 extension payment actually
paid in April 2026 for 2025 entered the 2026 canonical request. The
incomplete 2026 rule pack still prevented a calculation.

`6fb71550` keeps the payment dates and amounts and requires an actual IRS
application record for older unbound estimates and extensions after a
year change. `a41312b3` adds annual confirmation for manual gambling and
direct itemized amounts. `53d8f46d` also holds the retained allocation of
non-W-2 withholding to other schedules under either deduction election.
Independent review reproduced the allocation's effect on the standard
deduction comparison and verified that formatting-only changes preserve
confirmation. The intake changes retain entered cents and leave the tax
formulas and 2026 rule-pack gate in place.

`891f921b` requires renewed confirmation of retained alimony and Schedule H
amounts and gives each section an initial entry choice for wage-only filers.
Saved eligibility and FUTA answers remain dormant when the taxpayer has no
amounts. They require review if the taxpayer enters amounts after changing
years. Normal section replacement keeps pending markers. Editing underlying
facts after confirmation reopens the review, and formatting the same
Decimal amount preserves it. Both standalone converters require the
selected year for previously bound facts. Independent review reproduced the
dormant-answer and ordinary reducer gaps before they were closed.

The combined checks passed 430 tests in nine focused suites, all seven
specification lines, the coverage inventory and web type checking. Scoped
lint reported zero errors and three existing warnings. The exact tracked

## November 21 retained mortgage points on multiple statements

In `9225bb7f`, the guided return reconciles retained points by the actual
original lender and account. Before the fix, placing one $800 payoff
worksheet on two otherwise eligible statements raised federal itemized
deductions from $20,800 to $21,600. The duplicate claim now holds after
save and reopen. Separate original loans from the same lender retain their
own deductions.

For a linked same-lender refinancing, the old-loan payment history and
the completed successor worksheet can record amounts for separate periods.
The successor worksheet must explicitly cover only the successor period

## November 19 prior-return ownership of capital loss carryovers

`21446bb8` collects the preceding return year, worksheet reference, filing type,
loss owner and signed amounts in the guided Schedule D worksheet. Separate
owner amounts reconcile by character on a current joint return. A taxpayer
filing separately claims only their own portion of a prior joint loss. A whole
prior joint amount requires explicit confirmation that the same couple filed
together. Older amount-only advanced entries retain their calculation and carry
no source confirmation. Guided drafts retain their entered amounts and request
the missing worksheet details before calculation.
[IRS Schedule D instructions](https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i1040sd) ·
[IRS Publication 550, Joint and separate returns](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p550) ·
[Independent reviewer cases](upgrade-2026-human-tax-review-packet.md#ownership-when-filing-status-changes).

## November 19 Schedule A property-tax source year

Schedule A holds a positive real-estate tax on an explicitly wrong-year Form
1098 before it can feed line 5b, SALT or deduction selection. Matching-year
amounts, legacy undated amounts, separately reported qualified payments and
an explicit wrong-year zero keep their existing treatment. For escrow, the
deduction follows the lender's actual payment to the taxing authority.
[IRC §164](https://uscode.house.gov/us/usc/t26/s164/) ·
[IRS Publication 530](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p530).

explicit standard deduction choices. Both source specs and the full browser
audit passed. The scoped lint run retained one existing warning. The exact
combined revision `56a7ef3d` passed nine static and build checks and the
Docker workflow. Exact unit and coverage runs each passed 29,485 tests
across 2,156 files, with 88.34% branch coverage and normal PostgreSQL
shutdown. The 2026 worksheet remains behind the existing filing gate.

GitHub CI and Docker passed for this exact source. The managed browser job
passed 648 cases, with two saved-PDF inspection timeouts and five original
skips. Strict AMD64 passed 642, with eight 30-second deadlines and five
original skips. Strict image smoke, Compose recovery, independent archive

## November 19 Ohio nonresident and part-year unemployment

The canonical 2025 IT NRC reconciles one ordinary whole-dollar Form 1099-G
Box 1 with the same owner's original and federal Schedule 1 line 7. A part-year
filer needs a complete originally documented payment or accrual date and
amount. The validated domicile on that date determines the Ohio amount in
IT NRC line 12 Column B. A full-year nonresident has zero Ohio unemployment.
The tests confirm the original moves to the unemployment category once and
verify the state result after serializing and reloading the source packet.
[Ohio Revised Code §5747.20](https://codes.ohio.gov/ohio-revised-code/section-5747.20) ·
[2025 IT NRC worksheet](https://dam.assets.ohio.gov/image/upload/tax.ohio.gov/forms/ohio_individual/individual/2025/itnrc.pdf) ·
[Line 12 instructions](https://dam.assets.ohio.gov/image/upload/v1735920104/tax.ohio.gov/forms/ohio_individual/individual/2025/it1040-booklet.pdf#page=36).

The independent examples put a $1,000 benefit at the June 30 and July 1
domicile boundary. They yield credits of $1,420 and $1,396, respectively. The
full-year nonresident control yields $1,885. Both the source reconciliation
and competing school-error regressions failed before correction. Final tests
passed 485 cases across nine files, with 21 spec links, production lint and
typecheck. Independent checks passed 278 cases and a final 72-case rerun. The
isolated exact browser source audit passed. The later guided package collects
the same single-payment proof. Fractional Box 1, other benefit programs,
repayments and mixed-source cohorts remain outside this method. The 2026 filing
gate remains closed.

## November 19 Child Tax Credit relationship checks

The guided interview and the Schedule 8812 eligibility calculation now hold
a Child Tax Credit claim paired with the explicit parent, grandparent or other
qualifying-relative category. The raw API also holds the exact `parent` and
`other` values on a CTC claim. A return with an older `other` value needs the
actual qualifying relationship before calculation. Confirmed Credit for Other
Dependents claims and supported free-form qualifying-child relationships
continue through the existing calculation.
[IRC §24(c)](https://uscode.house.gov/us/usc/t26/s24/) ·
[IRC §152(c)(2)](https://uscode.house.gov/us/usc/t26/s152/).

Both regression tests failed before implementation. The corrected 2025 engine
returns $500 on Form 1040 line 19 for the confirmed ODC fixture and $2,200 for
the qualifying half-sibling fixture. The 2026 check exercises eligibility and
verifies the public federal calculation remains gated. The broader suite passed
201 tests across eight files. Independent review and 11 tests passed, as did
the engine and web typechecks, production lint, 63 scoped spec references and
the full browser source audit. The tracked-only `d52a596b` archive passed all
nine static and build checks on Node 26.13.1. With synthetic loopback
PostgreSQL 16.16, unit and coverage each passed 29,477 tests in 2,155 files.
Branch coverage reached 88.33% against the unchanged 85% gate. Running the two
commands serially avoided the earlier concurrent run's worker timeouts. The
owned PostgreSQL instance stopped normally.

The follow-up reproduced a $2,200 CTC on actual 2025 Form 1040 line 19 for
the raw relationships `grandparent`, `grandmother` and `other qualifying relative`.
It now holds explicit parent and grandparent labels and the full phrase
`other qualifying relative`, using whole-label case and whitespace normalization.
Independent review found the initial normalization also held legacy bare `Other`
values. The final regression preserves title-case or padded bare values and
keeps the exact lowercase `other` category held. Confirmed ODC still yields
$500, and the qualifying sibling and descendant controls still yield $2,200.
Independent checks passed 11 tests and all 16 Form 8812 spec references. The
broader suite passed 201 tests. The root check passed 39 tests and the full
spec and browser audits. Public 2026 calculation remains gated.

Coverage runs use a 15s per-test deadline, because eight tests exceeded 5s on a slow runner while the normal job passed them at 5s. Two long browser journeys use the 90s repository default in the 30s container job. ## Baseline and security patch package

- Node 24.22.1, pnpm 10.34.8, Node 24 types; versions verified against the
  official npm registry and [Node release](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.22.1).
- Compatible requested dependency updates, retaining TypeScript 5.9.3,
  Decimal.js 10.6.0 and pdf-lib 1.17.1. Next remains 15.5.28 in this first package.
  Vite 7.3.7 and PostCSS 8.5.23 address transitive advisories; OpenTelemetry API
  1.9.0 satisfies the SDK's `<1.10.0` peer requirement.
- Hash-pinned Python/pypdf setup and explicit interpreter selection; deterministic
  committed coverage inventory with a stale-file check. The inventory records
  implementation references and is explicitly not filing qualification.
- The auth limiter regression test isolates Better Auth's password delay;
  separate auth tests still exercise Better Auth. CORS tests resolve Next from
  the web workspace, avoiding an accidental hoisted dependency.
- Hosted production requires Redis at startup and rejects protected operations
  on missing configuration, errors, or Upstash's fail-open timeout response.
  Local/self-host requests retain memory limits. Outage responses are 503, quota
  responses remain 429. Tests simulate independent local stores and recovery;
  live Redis/multi-instance staging validation remains required.
- CI now requires coverage, contracts/web type checks, inventory freshness,
  browser flows on every PR, and an image smoke/SBOM job. Docker copies public
  assets and blank templates. These workflows are configured, not yet run remotely.

## PDF.js 6 security migration and browser baseline

PDF.js is pinned to 6.4.299, with a matching bundled browser worker. Extraction
releases pages/loading tasks, disables worker resource fetching, and bounds the

text only. Two real-library synthetic tests check exact text, page order,
malformed input and subsequent recovery. Web type checking and production build
pass. The post-migration audit reports zero advisories (488 dependency entries).
This is an advisory scan, not a security certification or deployed SBOM.

The full browser baseline exposed obsolete onboarding helpers and was stopped
after repeated failures; its upload/confirmation/export lifecycle is not yet
qualified. Next's local generated agent guidance is retained.

worksheet result after phase-down ($20,000 maximum/$5,000 floor). Form 2555
exclusions and housing deduction are added back, with explicit Puerto Rico and
Form 4563 addback inputs. Schedule A audit lines 5b–5e now match the published form.

including moving full phase-out and exact-tax-liability cases to the new credit

reported amounts and SALT phase-down, not all 2025 eligibility/ACTC branches.

Task profiles now record model/provider/effort, versioned prompt/schema IDs,

## Container rehearsal and resource limit

The Dockerfile now includes public assets and blank templates, excludes nested
credential files, and disables build telemetry. The smoke script supports an
explicit Docker or Podman runtime. Next's documented webpack build worker and
memory optimization preserve custom aliases while releasing compiler memory
before TypeScript; the local production build, web type check and 73 focused
browser checks pass after that configuration change.

The first ARM64 Podman image build compiled JavaScript, then was killed with
exit 137 during TypeScript in the existing 4 GiB VM. The bounded-heap retry
stalled, and the VM stopped responding to build/SSH probes. After the approved
restart and resize to 8 GiB, the image built successfully with a 4 GiB build
limit and a 2560 MiB old-space limit. Podman permits only one active managed VM
([documentation](https://docs.podman.io/en/stable/markdown/podman-machine-start.1.html)).

The resulting `linux/arm64` image passes health, public asset, blank-template and
self-host auth smoke checks. Its full production Chromium run has **293 passes,
five hosted skips and zero failures**, with retries disabled (7.1 minutes).
The runtime uses Node 24.22.1 and UID 1001, has no provider keys, and runs in
self-host mode. Runtime old-space is limited to 384 MiB; V8 reports a 576 MiB
total heap limit, and native memory is additional. This is a local synthetic
rehearsal, not a production capacity or hosted-service qualification.
